question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Maladroit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Skilful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Maladroit**" means lacking skill, clumsiness, or being awkward in one's actions or behaviour. (कौशल की कमी)

 
 
• **Example**: *She made a maladroit attempt to juggle the fragile glassware, causing it to shatter on the floor.*
